## Education

**PhD, Fisheries, Wildlife, and Conservation Sciences** — Oregon State University,
Corvallis, Oregon. Expected 2027. Major advisor: Dr. Ivan Arismendi.
Graduate committee: Dr. Jonny Armstrong, Dr. Mike Burns, Dr. Rebecca
Flitcroft (Pacific Northwest Research Station, USDA Forest Service); Graduate
Council Representative: Dr. Ha-Yeon Cheong.
Research focus: ecological interactions among non-native Smallmouth Bass,
native Signal Crayfish, and non-native Ringed Crayfish in Oregon river
systems.

**MEd, Gifted Education** *(Summa Cum Laude)* — Flinders University, Adelaide,
Australia, 2019–2021.
Thesis: a statistical study of the effects of electronic games on gifted students.

**BEd, Biology** — King Khalid University, Abha, Saudi Arabia, 1994–1998.
Project: survey of significant plant species of the Tihama and Asir regions.

## Research and professional experience

**Graduate Researcher** — Oregon State University, Corvallis, Oregon. Present.
Field and experimental research on freshwater invasions and predator–prey
dynamics; pilot-phase laboratory predation and thermal-choice trials with
video-based behavioral analysis; statistical analysis in R supporting
conservation-relevant questions in the Willamette and Umpqua systems.

**Lecturer and Trainer, Environmental Sustainability** — Principles of Environmental
Sustainability Program, Qunfudhah, Saudi Arabia. May 2012 – September 2017.
Trained conservation professionals and park rangers in ecological assessment and
wildlife management; delivered technical workshops on water quality monitoring;
contributed to conservation work in the Wadi Hali region.

**Biology Teacher** — Ministry of Education, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Since January 1999.
Designed and taught inquiry-based biology curricula; integrated data analysis and
spatial tools into classroom science; led development of an environmental science
curriculum adopted by five regional schools; mentored students to regional and
national science fair recognition.

## Skills

**Quantitative.** R and RStudio, generalized and mixed-effects models, Jacobs'
electivity index, GIS (ArcGIS Pro), SPSS, experimental design.

**Behavioral and video analysis.** BORIS behavioral coding, ToxTrac,
Fiji/TrackMate, DeepLabCut.

**Laboratory and field.** Fish diet analysis, crayfish trapping and hand
sampling, predator–prey and thermal-preference experimental design, water
quality measurement (pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity, nitrates), taxonomy
and species identification, microscopy, dissection and anatomical analysis,
temperature logger deployment.

**Reproducibility.** Quarto, Git and GitHub, Zotero with Better BibTeX.

**Teaching.** Curriculum development, inquiry-based science teaching, STEM
education, differentiated instruction, e-learning and virtual labs, scientific
mentoring.

**Languages.** Arabic (native), English (fluent).

## Certifications and professional development

- Inquiry-Based Teaching in Science (15 hours) — Educational Training Center
- Test Construction and Table of Specifications (15 hours) — Education Administration
- Differentiated Instruction and Active Learning (12 hours) — Education Office
- CoRT Thinking Skills Program (15 hours) — Education Office
- Research and Laboratory Safety Standards — International Academic Institution

Doctoral scholarship, Saudi Arabian Cultural Mission (SACM) and the Ministry
